data.one_liner: Proper Bangla text shaping, rendering, and extraction for PDF documents in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Corrects Bangla text shaping (conjuncts, reph, and vowel signs) for PDF generation using package:pdf drop-in widgets, and provides robust PDF text extraction and Bijoy decoding.
use_when: You need to generate PDFs containing accurate Bangla text, numbers, and currency.
You want to extract or search Bangla text from existing PDFs, including scanned or Word-exported files.
avoid_when: You do not work with PDFs or Bengali localization.
strengths: Real OpenType shaping for Bangla conjuncts and vowel signs with correct selection and searchability.
Drop-in replacement for standard package:pdf widgets via a single import.
Extracts text from complex PDFs including Word exports and legacy Bijoy documents.
weaknesses: Limited to PDF generation and extraction workflows.
Non-Bangla glyphs require explicit font fallbacks.
